request.prompt: Instrumental driving outrun synthwave for an arcade kart race through a neon Miami city at sunset. 124 BPM, A minor. Four-on-the-floor kick, gated snare, pulsing analog bass, a bright saw-lead hook, shimmering arpeggios. High energy that stays constant the whole way so it can loop under a race. No intro, no breakdown, no ending, no fade-out, no vocals.
